relNote: Pending vendor invoice header before posting; posting creates VendInvoiceJour

def.name: VendInvoiceInfoTable
def.description: Pending (unposted) vendor invoice header; the AP equivalent of CustInvoiceTable. Captures the vendor invoice as entered or received before it is posted to the ledger. After posting, header data moves to VendInvoiceJour.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: ParmId
fields.note: Internal parameter key linking this header to its VendInvoiceInfoLine rows and the posting session

fields.name: PurchId
fields.note: Purchase order being invoiced; null for non-PO (standalone) vendor invoices

fields.name: OrderAccount
fields.note: Vendor account that submitted the invoice

fields.name: InvoiceAccount
fields.note: Vendor account to be invoiced (may differ from OrderAccount for intercompany)

fields.name: DocumentNum
fields.note: Vendor's invoice document number; used for duplicate-invoice detection

fields.name: DocumentDate
fields.note: Date on the vendor's invoice document

fields.name: CurrencyCode
fields.note: Currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice

fields.name: MatchStatus
fields.note: Enum: invoice-to-PO matching status (Passed, Failed, Not applicable, etc.)

fields.name: Approved
fields.note: 1 if the invoice has been approved for posting; 0 if pending review

relNote: Pending vendor invoice line; FK to VendInvoiceInfoTable header via ParmId

def.name: VendInvoiceInfoLine
def.description: Individual line on a pending (unposted) vendor invoice; the AP equivalent of CustInvoiceLine. Each row holds one invoiced item or procurement category with quantity, price, and accounting. After posting, line data moves to VendInvoiceTrans.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: ParmId
fields.note: FK to the parent pending invoice header via the posting session parameter key

fields.name: ItemId
fields.note: Item number on this invoice line; null for procurement-category-only lines

fields.name: ProcurementCategory
fields.note: Procurement category for non-item (expense) invoice lines

fields.name: LineAmount
fields.note: Net line amount (qty x price minus discounts) in the invoice currency

fields.name: PurchPrice
fields.note: Unit purchase price from the PO or entered manually

fields.name: ReceiveNow
fields.note: Quantity being invoiced in purchase units (the 'update now' quantity)

fields.name: InventTransId
fields.note: Inventory transaction ID linking to the physical receipt for item-based lines

fields.name: PurchLineRecId
fields.note: FK to the purchase order line being invoiced

fields.name: DefaultDimension
fields.note: Default financial dimensions for this invoice line
